scripts.tauri:before-dev: pnpm run node:fetch && pnpm run sidecar:build && pnpm --filter @agentdeck/web dev
scripts.tauri:before-build: pnpm run node:fetch && pnpm run sidecar:build && pnpm --filter @agentdeck/web build:desktop
scripts.tauri:dev: pnpm run version:sync && pnpm exec tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: pnpm run license:sync && pnpm run version:sync && pnpm exec tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:debug: pnpm run license:sync && pnpm run version:sync && pnpm exec tauri build --debug
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run license:check && pnpm run version:check && pnpm run grid:check && pnpm -r run typecheck
